\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[red] (0,0) -- (2,0);
  % Not declared: PGF stops with "the requested layer 'nosuch' could not be
  % found"; in nonstop mode the content is drawn where it stands.
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{nosuch}
    \draw[blue] (0,0.5) -- (2,0.5);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  \draw[green] (0,1) -- (2,1);
\end{tikzpicture}
